segments.title: Storm Water Utility Reduction
description: Council approved a reduction in storm water utility funding, which may require future rate adjustments to maintain flood control strategies.

segments.title: Youth Sports Subsidy Reduction
description: Council voted against reducing the youth sports subsidy but approved a motion for administration to report on its distribution and impact across income levels and organizations.

segments.title: Social Services Cash Grant Program
description: Council approved a motion for administration to report on the social services cash grant program, including its distribution and alignment with municipal responsibilities.

segments.title: Detox Center Grant Reduction
description: Council approved a 50% reduction to the detox center grant in 2026 and its elimination in 2027, with a report back on its history and background.

segments.title: Youth Centers Grant Reduction (E-Gads)
description: The motion to reduce the grant for E-Gads (youth centers) was withdrawn after clarification that it is the city's sole youth center funding.

segments.title: Special Events Funding Policy Adjustment
description: The motion to reduce the city's contribution to special events from 25% to 12.5% was withdrawn after discussion about its impact on competitiveness.

segments.title: Indoor Arena Rate Increase
description: Council approved increasing indoor arena rates by 6.5% over two years to achieve 100% cost recovery, including summer ice rentals.

segments.title: Outdoor Pool Admission Rate Increase
description: Council defeated a motion to increase outdoor pool admission rates to match indoor leisure centers, citing concerns about cost as a barrier.

segments.title: Outdoor Pool Operating Dates Reduction
description: The motion to reduce outdoor pool operating dates by opening later and closing earlier was withdrawn after discussion.

segments.title: Pet Licensing Rate Increase
description: Council approved a 2.5% increase in pet licensing rates for 2026 and 2027, placing Saskatoon at the high end of market comparables.

segments.title: Golf Course Return on Investment
description: Council approved establishing a $105,000 return on investment from golf courses in 2026 and 2027, which will slightly increase user fees.
